verdict.rationale: Muse is itself a personal AI agent, and the evidence documents delegation in depth. Users set goals or tasks in chat or the Goals tab, and Muse keeps working on a schedule and in response to events, following up and sending notifications. It also builds its own tools and connectors, and it acts on email, bookings, budgets and purchases with approval cards and an audit trail. Community comments corroborate everyday use, though one stress test found the agent control plane timing out under load. Missing for 10: rigorous independent hands-on verification that delegated tasks complete reliably, given the reported timeouts under load.
